title: The Alliance, The Gasworks, Barrow Street, Dublin 4
seoTitle: The Alliance, The Gasworks, Barrow Street, Dublin 4

prs.location:
Next door to Google’s European Headquarters, The Alliance takes pride of place in this urban quarter, bringing a sense of heritage to a district famed for its incredible eateries, sociable atmosphere and ability to attract innovative companies. 

If you like staying local, you have plenty to entertain you with walks along the leafy Grand Canal, the lush Merrion Square nearby along with Aviva Stadium, Bord Gais Energy Theatre and a host of gyms. 

Your inner foodie will appreciate Juniors Deli & Café and Farmer Browns for elevenses and lunch, along with the Schoolhouse Hotel, The Bath Pub, The Chophouse and The Old Spot among other incredible eateries, conveniently located nearby, for tasty evenings out. 

With only a 15-minute walk to St. Stephen’s Green, you can meet friends last minute or hop on the Dart at Grand Canal Dock, which is 100 metres from your door. You can even hire a bike with Dublinbikes just five minutes away at Herbert Place.

description:
These tasteful 1 and 2 bedroom apartments, among 210 residences within a listed landmark building, give living history new meaning in a sensitively restored district overlooking the leafy Grand Canal.

Welcome the morning sun as it fills each modern interior, complementing the character of the original Victorian gasometer wherein each apartment lies. A central open atrium captures the sunlight, creating bright and airy interiors, highlighting the flawless design detail and finish. 

Rising to eight floors, each residence in The Alliance, next door to Google's European Headquarters, brings nature closer with views of the landscaped gardens, birdlife on the Grand Canal or stunning vistas of the city skyline. 

Neighbouring parks like Merrion Square give residents in this historic quarter time to reflect and admire the ornamental plants in this Georgian garden along with the redbrick townhouses that border it. 

Dedicated onsite property managers set the bar high for service. Ready to accommodate, these friendly professionals tend to your needs diligently, along with maintaining privacy and safety. 

Join a community of leisure lovers, foodies, culture fans and design devotees who enjoy the pace of life in this reimagined part of the city.

Virtual tours enable you to view apartments while respecting social distancing guidelines. They are helpful in illustrating the layout and interior style of a sample residence.
